name: KidVenture Summer Day Camp
description_short: Indoor day camp at the Branchburg Sports Complex for children entering kindergarten through 7th grade. Campers grouped by age rotate through laser tag, the PlayMaze, gaga, arcade time and field and court games, by the full day, half day or single day.
refund_policy_summary: KidVenture registrations cancelled by April 1 get a full refund. After that, cancelling at least a day ahead earns an account credit to use by the end of summer; same day absences get no credit.
notes: Full day $425 a week or $85 a day; half day $250 a week or $50 a day. AM care 8:00 to 9:00 $10 a day; PM care 4:00 to 5:30 $16 a day with snack. Lunch $6 a day; pizza free for full day campers on Fridays. A $20 yearly BSC membership is required. Camp starts June 21, 2027; the 2027 weekly schedule is not posted yet. Half day sports camps (baseball, basketball, flag football, soccer, multi sport) and a Leaders in Training program for grades 8 and 9 also run.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. KidVenture page, updated for 2027: kids at least 5 by June 21, 2027 and entering K to 7th grade in fall 2027 (page also says ages 5 to 13). Camp begins June 21, 2027; schedule coming soon. Pricing section carries no year. Lunch is an optional $6 add on.
